description: Runnable benchmark suite for the BCER public release. Each task references a contract in configs/tasks_registry.json; dataset_root and case_manifest values are placeholders — replace them with local paths or generate a shared case manifest with scripts/manifest_builder.py.
notes: This file intentionally contains no internal dataset paths; dataset_root and case_manifest use <REPLACE_WITH_...> placeholders.
Each task_id maps to a full contract (required_modalities, success_criteria, invariants, fault_profiles) in configs/tasks_registry.json.

Build the shared case manifest with: python scripts/manifest_builder.py --tasks-registry configs/tasks_registry.json --prostate-root <ROOT> --brain-root <ROOT> --cardiac-root <ROOT> --output cases_manifest.jsonl (the builder buckets cases by domain and records which tasks each case supports).
Run one task with: python benchmark/benchmark_runner.py --task <task_id> --tasks-registry configs/tasks_registry.json --manifest <case_manifest> --arm <arm> [--fault <fault>].
Paper-result reproduction still needs a separate RESULT_PROVENANCE.md mapping manuscript tables to exact artifacts and commands.
